entities.summary: The Pittsburgh Agreement (1918) promised Slovak autonomy within Czechoslovakia. Rapid modernisation under the First Republic but growing tensions over Czech centralisation and the Slovak autonomy movement led by Andrej Hlinka's People's Party.
